Anthropic Cyber Verification Program — cached 2026-10-07 (announced 2026-10-06)
https://www.anthropic.com/news/cyber-verification-program
NOTE: /news/expanding-the-cyber-verification-program 404s. Use the slug above.
Consolidates the original CVP + PROJECT GLASSWING into ONE three-tier program.
All tiers grant: Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, CLAUDE MYTHOS 5.1, and new models
  going forward.
TIER 1 — Defense Access: SOC and incident response, reverse-engineering malware,
  analyzing and validating vulnerabilities. Qualifying: security teams at companies,
  nonprofits, universities and government bodies defending systems they own or maintain;
  critical-infrastructure operators OF ANY SIZE (regional hospitals, municipal utilities);
  smaller security firms; open-source maintainers; individual researchers with a track
  record of reported vulnerabilities.
TIER 2 — Red Team Access: adds authorized penetration testing and red-teaming to the
  defensive uses above. Qualifying: in-house red teams, government red teams, security and
  penetration testing firms. RETAINS real-time blocks on actions that could cause physical
  harm or mass disruption — deploying ransomware, damaging physical systems, pen testing
  high-risk safety systems.
TIER 3 — Specialized Access: FEWEST CYBER BLOCKS. Reserved for a limited set of verified
  organizations authorized to test safety systems that could impact people's lives or
  disrupt markets — flight operating systems, power grids, telecom networks, interbank
  transfer infrastructure, government administrative networks.
Reported results: Glasswing partners found 129,000 verified software vulnerabilities
  Apr-Jul 2026; Anthropic open-source scanning found +5,500 Apr-Oct 2026; more than 33,000
  rated critical or high severity.
=> FOURTH confirmed instance of guardrail-by-ENTITLEMENT (not per-model). Refusal-based
   red-team probes on a standard key do NOT reproduce a CVP-entitled key's behavior.
